name: Founder decision: Decide where the employee area and the lockers are
text_content:
Finding 19.11. The record commits smart lockers for every team member and a real employee area with a break space (WP p.19 to 20). Canon's spatial sequence, materiality matrix, and pre-CD open items describe a 2,310 square foot converted bungalow with no employee area in any of them. The locker is assigned before the start date and the area is walked on the first shift. The founders close it with the design team as a pre-CD item. Blocks readiness row 86's locker condition and the arrival note's locker line. High.

Filed by Session 7 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhrz. Reasoning lives on the S7 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
